description: This file defines a React component 'SuperNoteOptions' which provides UI options for a note, including toggling markdown preview and exporting in various formats (JSON, Markdown, HTML). It includes UI elements like menus, icons, and popovers, and interacts with command services for exporting notes.

methods.name: SuperNoteOptions
methods.description: React functional component rendering options for a note, including markdown preview toggle and export menu with options for JSON, Markdown, and HTML formats.
